newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILFIMA BROKERAGE HOUSE MOST ACTIVE IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: VILFIMA BROKERAGE HOUSE MOST ACTIVE IN MAY.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that Vilfima was the country's most active brokerage house in May, accounting for 31.48 percent of total turnover.
The bourse said in a statement that Vilfima had a total turnover of 37.67 million litas last month.
Suprema was second with 13.03 percent of total bourse turnover in May, making deals worth 15.59 million litas.
Vilniaus Bank's brokerage house came third in terms of total turnover with business of 11.52 million litas or 9.61 percent of the market in May.

Vilfima also was the most active brokerage house in trading securities in May with turnover of 37.67 million litas or 37.7 percent of total securities turnover. It registered no business in government T-bills last month.
Vilfima was followed by Suprema with 14.71 percent of May's securities market turnover and Hermis brokerage was third with 9.84 percent.
Suprema turned over 14.69 million litas and Hermis 9.83 million litas in securities trade.
The brokerage house of Lithuania's Agricultural Bank was the most active in the T-bill market in May with 39.22 percent of total turnover or 7.75 million litas.

Vilnaius Bank's brokerage house had 13.91 pecent of May's market in government T-bills with a turnover of 2.75 million litas followed by Achema Securities with a 13.85 percent share in turnover of 2.74 million litas.
